text:
Aluminium is extracted from its ore by electrolysis.
What is the role of cryolite in this process?
A
to lower the operating temperature
B
to lower the boiling point of bauxite
C
to raise the melting point of bauxite
D
to act as a catalyst

options.label: B
options.text: to lower the boiling point of bauxite

options.label: C
options.text: to raise the melting point of bauxite
